seo.description: Hire nearshore software development teams in Colombia with Agencia IDP. Senior engineers in US time zones, bilingual communication, competitive rates and guaranteed quality.

blocks.text: Strategic partners for your technology growth

blocks.html: At Agencia IDP we connect Colombian talent with companies around the world that want to build high-quality software in an agile, cost-effective way without losing control of their projects. Our nearshore model gives you a team aligned with your time zone, with smooth communication, a compatible culture and competitive costs.

blocks.html: Colombia has become one of the strongest technology hubs in Latin America. When you choose us as your nearshore development partner, you get:
Developers, designers, software architects and QA engineers with international experience.
We work in your time zone if you are in the US or Canada.
Clear communication in English and Spanish.
And secure working environments.
That support the export of technology services.
Make your technology budget go further with highly skilled talent in Colombia, at more competitive rates than in the US.

blocks.q: What hours do you work and how do you coordinate with other countries?
blocks.a: Our team works Colombian business hours (GMT-5), which overlap with most North American time zones and part of Europe. We use tools such as Slack, Zoom, Trello and Notion to stay coordinated, with weekly or daily agile meetings depending on the engagement model.
Yes. We have bilingual (English–Spanish) talent trained for international projects, and we can work in the client’s language for documentation, meetings and support.

Our teams are made up of professionals with proven experience on local and international projects for startups, mid-size companies and enterprises, across innovation, digital transformation, AI, e-commerce, fintech, insurance, healthcare, education and more.

blocks.q: What technologies do you work with?
blocks.a:
We work with modern, scalable technologies such as:

  • Frontend: React, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind

  • Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Laravel, Django

  • Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes

  • Integrations: REST and GraphQL APIs, payment gateways, CRM, ERP, RPA and more

blocks.q: How do you handle security and confidentiality?
blocks.a: We sign non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) and follow security best practices: access control, encryption, regular backups and secure staging environments. We also adapt to your compliance policies.

blocks.q: Can you scale the team if the project grows?
blocks.a: Yes. We can start with a small team and grow it as the workload increases. Our agile onboarding lets us add new profiles quickly without losing continuity.
